List all students in one of the teacher's assigned groups.

Use the returned `studentUserId` values as inputs to the per-student dashboard.

**Forbidden** if the teacher is not assigned to `group_id`.

schema.title: Response List Students In Group Analytics Teacher Groups  Group Id  Students Get

get.description:
Class-level analytics dashboard for one of the teacher's assigned groups.

Returns all widgets at the class level:
- Exam completion rate (total assigned = active_exams × students)
- Average score across the whole class
- Top N performers (default 5, max 50 via `?limit`)
- Academic standards heatmap (per subject, per mastery level, student counts)
- Detailed student performance table (one row per student, sorted by avg %)

**Forbidden** if the teacher is not assigned to `group_id`.

parameters.name: limit

schema.description: Number of top performers to return

get.description:
Per-student analytics dashboard.

Returns all 6 widgets for a specific student:
- Exam completion rate (vs exams assigned to their class)
- Average score
- Performance progression (chronological bar chart data)
- Academic standards heatmap (per subject mastery)
- Detailed per-exam performance table

**Forbidden** if the student does not belong to any of the teacher's assigned groups.

get.description:

Returns all 6 widgets:
- Exam completion rate (vs exams assigned to child's class)
- Average score (% achieved)
- Rank in class + class size
- Performance progression (chronological per-attempt bar chart data)
- Academic standards heatmap (per subject, mastery level)
- Detailed per-exam performance table with topic breakdown

**Forbidden** if `student_user_id` is not linked to this parent account.

Payload for TEACHER / ORG_ADMIN to create a single Student.

- ``roll_number``: Student's roll number (required).
- ``parent_email``: Parent account is auto-created (or linked if already exists). Required.
- ``parent_phone``: Parent's phone number, stored on the parent user record. Required.

EncryptedLoginRequest.title: EncryptedLoginRequest
EncryptedLoginRequest.description:
RSA+AES encrypted login payload, matching the existing frontend encryption convention.

The frontend encrypts ``{"email": "...", "password": "..."}`` using AES-CBC,
then RSA-encrypts the AES key. The three ciphertext components are sent here.
